sentences.en: Having fallen victim to increased competition, the company went bankrupt.
sentences.zh: 由于竞争加剧，这家公司破产了。

sentences.en: We were financially troubled, in short, we were bankrupt.
sentences.zh: 我们财务上出了问题，可以说就是破产了。

sentences.en: This plan will bankrupt the economy of our town.
sentences.zh: 这个计划会让小镇的经济破产。

senses.zh: 破产的, 倒闭的 - 完全缺乏的 -
使破产, 使枯竭, 使极端贫困
